config.neo4j.cypher.topic.crdb.public.customers: WITH __value AS cdcEvent, __key AS cdcKey FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN cdcEvent.op IN ['c','u','r'] THEN [1] ELSE [] END | MERGE (c:Customer {id: cdcKey.id}) SET c.name = cdcEvent.after.name, c.email = cdcEvent.after.email, c.tier = cdcEvent.after.tier) WITH cdcEvent, cdcKey OPTIONAL MATCH (dc:Customer {id: cdcKey.id}) WHERE cdcEvent.op = 'd' DETACH DELETE dc
config.neo4j.cypher.topic.crdb.public.orders: WITH __value AS cdcEvent, __key AS cdcKey FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN cdcEvent.op IN ['c','u','r'] THEN [1] ELSE [] END | MERGE (o:Order {id: cdcKey.id}) SET o.amount = cdcEvent.after.amount, o.status = cdcEvent.after.status MERGE (c:Customer {id: cdcEvent.after.customer_id}) MERGE (c)-[:PLACED]->(o)) WITH cdcEvent, cdcKey OPTIONAL MATCH (dor:Order {id: cdcKey.id}) WHERE cdcEvent.op = 'd' DETACH DELETE dor
